title: Russian QuakeWorld League
wikitext:
{{RQWL_Navbox}} '''Russian QuakeWorld League''' is a series of tournaments on QuakeWorld. Most of the tournaments were in the '''1on1''' and '''2on2''' categories, although '''FFA''' and '''4on4''' also took place. The tournaments have been held for over 20 years, although the main activity was in the 00s. The main binding element is that Russian-speaking people play in the tournament.

People who made the main contribution to the '''RQWL''' tournament series: {{Player|Doomah|flag=ru}} {{Player|Fei|flag=ru}} {{Player|gLAd|flag=ru}} {{Player|GroMM|flag=ru}} {{Player|kreon|flag=ru}}
